official_rubric_r01_r19.name: Loai bai toan thuoc nhom luu tru, thu thap, truc quan, xu ly
official_rubric_r01_r19.evidence: Dac ta KKBox Churn + pipeline DVC (dvc.yaml) + Serving API + Web UI.
official_rubric_r01_r19.deduction_reason: Dat 100% tren moi truong hien tai.

official_rubric_r01_r19.name: Loai du lieu: Dataset/Database/Web
official_rubric_r01_r19.evidence: KKBox manifest: 4 bang (member, churn_label, subscription_transaction, listening_day), 442,211,685 dong.
official_rubric_r01_r19.deduction_reason: Dat 100% tren moi truong hien tai.

official_rubric_r01_r19.name: Dung luong >4 GB; so sanh xu ly local va Cloud
official_rubric_r01_r19.evidence: Local KKBox raw: 844.63 MB (0.825 GB, 6 tep); Manifest 7.52 GB / 32 tep; Local scan 37,629,251 dong trong 5.61s.
official_rubric_r01_r19.deduction_reason: Tru 0.75d: Du lieu thô local dat 844.63 MB (0.825 GB < 4 GiB) va chua chay cung job tren Azure Cloud.

official_rubric_r01_r19.name: Co so ly thuyet thuat toan, luong xu ly
